title: BitGo acquires NYDIG institutional trading arm for $42.5M plus $15M earnout
dek: BitGo has acquired NYDIG's institutional trading business for approximately $42.5 million in cash and stock, plus a $15 million earnout. The deal brings about 30 employees, client relationships, and capabilities in derivatives, structured products, and capital markets to BitGo, while NYDIG refocuses on power and data-center operations.
author: Crypto Cronkite
key_fact: The deal comprises $7 million in cash and around $35.5 million in stock, plus $15 million earnout.
bottom_line: Watch for how BitGo integrates NYDIG's 30-person trading team and client book into its existing custody and settlement stack. body: BitGo has acquired NYDIG's institutional trading business for approximately $42.5 million in cash and stock plus a $15 million earnout, according to CoinDesk's reporting. The deal comprises $7 million in cash and around $35.5 million in stock, with the earnout contingent on unspecified performance milestones.

The acquisition brings about 30 employees and established client relationships to BitGo, along with capabilities in derivatives trading, structured products, and capital-markets services. BitGo integrates these functions into its existing institutional offering, which centers on custody and settlement infrastructure.

NYDIG, which stands for New York Digital Investment Group, is refocusing its operations around power and data-center business lines following the sale. The trading arm had served the crypto institutional market but is no longer central to the parent company's strategy.
